verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Gemini can import/upload code repositories and files for analysis (gemini-docs-1/2/13/14/25), but nothing describes an actual code-execution/interpreter capability that runs code on uploaded data to generate charts, computed answers, or downloadable output files. Missing for 10: any documentation of a code-interpreter/sandbox execution feature, chart/plot generation from data, or file export of computed results.
